description: Opaque deep plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, a fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and restrained gold patterned borders at the neckline, shoulders, cuffs and front skirt edges. Small round gold clasps fasten the shoulder straps; a decorative gold belt with a round central clasp sits at the waist. A cream underdress shows between the open front skirt panels. A long cream wrap with purple-gold borders rests around the arms and hangs down each side. Small gold drop earrings, rings and a simple bracelet are visible, with a gold-patterned closed shoe at the hem. No armor, headgear or weapon is visible.
